boundaries: Results on the Calibration Set are development evidence, not held-out validation.
A response used to tune a model cannot later become untouched test evidence for that model.
claim_ceiling: Generated project-scoped candidate Definition record only. Shape and projection checks grant no Lab admission, semantic truth, implementation, collection or employment-use authority.

scope.applicability: One development phase and pinned score version.
exclusions: Any other product or Lab-wide meaning without separate owner review and admission.

domain_context.explanation: Candidate Calibration Set meaning for the Engineer Assessment product and research program. Its construct, implementation and use claims remain bounded by the source statement.

plain_language.explanation: This is where the scoring procedure is learned and repaired.

boundary_conditions: Results on the Calibration Set are development evidence, not held-out validation.
A response used to tune a model cannot later become untouched test evidence for that model.
scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Calibration Set is a versioned collection of responses and ratings assigned before validation to train raters, refine anchors, fit permitted scoring parameters and find failure cases.
